segments.text: There are several important work practices that researchers can do to ensure good performance of fume hoods.
segments.zh: 研究人员可以采取几种重要的工作规范，以确保通风柜性能良好。

segments.text: Fume hoods are checked and certified annually, and a sticker on the front should show the date of certification,
segments.zh: 通风柜每年都要检查和认证，前面应贴有标签，显示认证日期，

segments.text: along with the average face velocity measured during the testing.
segments.zh: 以及测试时测得的平均面风速。

segments.text: Each hood should also have a functional airflow monitor or alarm.
segments.zh: 每台通风柜还应配有正常工作的气流监测器或报警器。

segments.text: These alarms indicate if the airflow to the hood is at the right level.
segments.zh: 这些报警器显示通风柜的气流是否处于合适的水平。

segments.text: When the airflow is too low, the alarm will alert the user.
segments.zh: 气流过低时，报警器会提醒使用者。

segments.text: When this happens, the user should stop work, close the sash, and alert their manager and health and safety team.
segments.zh: 出现这种情况时，使用者应停止工作，关上视窗，并通知主管和健康安全团队。

segments.text: The low airflow alarm in many fume hood models has an audible feature as well as the visual notification.
segments.zh: 许多型号通风柜的低气流报警器除了有视觉提示外，还有声音报警功能。

segments.text: The audible alarm can often be disabled, however, it can be reset.
segments.zh: 声音报警通常可以被关闭，不过也可以重新设置。

segments.text: Keeping the alarm in an audible mode is a good work practice to ensure the user will realize there is a problem.
segments.zh: 让报警器保持在声音报警模式是一种良好的工作规范，可以确保使用者意识到出现了问题。

segments.text: To reset the alarm, press the reset button and hold it down for about 30 seconds.
segments.zh: 要重置报警器，按下复位按钮并按住大约 30 秒。

segments.text: The display will light up with a bunch of information, and then you can release the button.
segments.zh: 显示屏会亮起并显示一堆信息，这时就可以松开按钮了。

segments.text: To make the detector go into alarm mode, on some fume hoods there is a hole on the wall inside the fume hood.
segments.zh: 要让检测器进入报警模式，有些通风柜内壁上有一个小孔。

segments.text: You can put your finger over the hole blocking it, and that will reduce the airflow and cause the unit to go into alarm mode.
segments.zh: 你可以用手指把这个孔堵住，这样会减小气流，使装置进入报警模式。

segments.text: For good containment of chemical fumes, the user should make sure the sash is at the proper height.
segments.zh: 为了良好地封闭化学烟气，使用者应确保视窗处于正确的高度。

segments.text: Fume hoods have glass sashes that slide to allow access.
segments.zh: 通风柜装有可以滑动的玻璃视窗，以便进行操作。

segments.text: A mark on the hood will show where the sash should be located for proper airflow velocity.
segments.zh: 通风柜上的标记会显示视窗应处于什么位置才能保证适当的风速。

segments.text: If the sash is too high, the air coming into the hood may slow to a point that the chemical vapors can leak out.
segments.zh: 如果视窗太高，进入通风柜的空气可能会减慢到化学蒸气能够泄漏出来的程度。

segments.text: The sash should be in between the worker's face and the chemicals inside the hood.
segments.zh: 视窗应位于操作人员的面部和通风柜内的化学品之间。

segments.text: If the bottom of the sash is near the nose or mouth, the hood may not be providing good protection.
segments.zh: 如果视窗底边靠近鼻子或嘴巴，通风柜可能就无法提供良好的防护。

segments.text: Generally, the user should be standing while working at the hood.
segments.zh: 一般来说，在通风柜前工作时使用者应该站着。

segments.text: If sitting, your face may be below the sash.
segments.zh: 如果坐着，你的脸可能会低于视窗。

segments.text: Never put your head inside the hood.
segments.zh: 千万不要把头伸进通风柜内。

segments.text: When the sash is lowered, the speed of the air entering the hood may increase resulting in greater turbulence and potential for leakage.
segments.zh: 视窗降低时，进入通风柜的风速可能会增大，造成更大的湍流和泄漏的可能。

segments.text: Many conditions can affect the efficiency and safe operation of a fume hood.
segments.zh: 许多情况都会影响通风柜的效率和安全运行。

segments.text: The hood should be kept free of unnecessary items.
segments.zh: 通风柜内不应放置不必要的物品。

segments.text: Only those items required for the task should be inside the hood.
segments.zh: 通风柜内只能放置工作所需的物品。

segments.text: Don't use the fume hood to store chemical containers.
segments.zh: 不要用通风柜存放化学品容器。

segments.text: Keep the back vent free of items.
segments.zh: 不要让物品挡住后部排风口。

segments.text: Good hood performance requires that airflow moves evenly across the work surface.
segments.zh: 通风柜要性能良好，需要气流均匀地流过工作台面。

segments.text: And keep the front of the hood clear too.
segments.zh: 通风柜的前部也要保持畅通。

segments.text: Items too close to the front grill still can disrupt the airflow coming under the sill and potentially leak out of the hood.
segments.zh: 离前格栅太近的物品仍然会扰乱从底槛下方流入的气流，并可能从通风柜中泄漏出来。

segments.text: When you are finished with your work, remove those items that are not expected to be necessary for upcoming procedures.
segments.zh: 工作完成后，把接下来的操作预计用不到的物品拿出去。

segments.text: Wipe down surfaces when finished with your work.
segments.zh: 工作完成后擦拭表面。

segments.text: That way, the hood is clean and ready to go when needed next.
segments.zh: 这样，下次需要使用时，通风柜就是干净的、随时可用的。
